blocks.content: Three projects, one idea. Software is given more independence only after it has shown that it works.

items.title: Callsheet
items.description: A public online directory of UK film, TV and media companies. It runs without staff.

items.title: Haios
items.description: A way to organise work for AI software using ordinary files and folders.

items.title: Behold
items.description: A simpler version of Haios that I use for my own daily work.
